content:
Integrating with respect to \(y\):

\[
x_{\text{line}}=y+4,\qquad x_{\text{parabola}}=\frac{y^2}{2}
\]

For \(y\in[-2,4]\), the line is to the right of the parabola, so

\[
A=\int_{-2}^{4}\left((y+4)-\frac{y^2}{2}\right)\,dy
\]

\[
=\left[\frac{y^2}{2}+4y-\frac{y^3}{6}\right]_{-2}^{4}
\]

\[
=\frac{40}{3}-\left(-\frac{14}{3}\right)=18
\]

\[
\boxed{18}
\]
